meta.title: Honest Review of Marble Mountains & Shopping in Da Nang | Complete Travel Guide 2026
meta.description:
Is the Marble Mountain tour worth the climb? Today, we’re exploring one of Da Nang’s most iconic landmarks! 🇻🇳 We tackle the "Stairs vs. Lift" debate first-hand and share our honest review of the entire experience, from ancient caves to cheap shopping.

Day 7 of our Vietnam Series: We headed to the famous Marble Mountains (Ngu Hanh Son), which are split into two main attractions: the mystical caves (including Am Phu Cave and Huyen Khong Cave) and the summit of Water Mountain.

In this vlog:

The Ultimate "Stairs vs. Lift" Challenge: We took separate paths to the summit to give you a complete perspective! Dilpreet opted for the convenience of the lift, while I challenged myself with the steep stone staircase to the top. We compare the views, the effort, and whether the climb is truly worth it.

Marble Mountain Caves: Exploring the dramatic, sun-dappled interior of the main caves.

Zumba on the Beach: Catching the local energy at Da Nang Beach with some sunset open-air Zumba.

Han Market Dash: We raced against the clock to reach Han Market just 15 minutes before its 7:00 PM closing!

Shopping Secret: We visited Vincom Plaza and discovered that VinMart is nearly 30% cheaper than other tourist shops in Da Nang for essentials and treats! 🛍️
